title: Introduction and overview — Littorio-class Battleship
description: Introduction and overview of the Littorio-class Battleship: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. Italy's Littorio class — three completed — were fast, handsome 45,000-ton battleships with nine 15-inch/50 guns, among the longest-ranged naval rifles ever. They fought the Royal Navy across the Mediterranean; Roma was sunk by German guided bombs in 1943, the first capital ship lost to guided missiles. Baseline facts: Italian battleship; 3 completed; nine 15-inch guns; Mediterranean battles..
